comment: R-em3d24-4b. Upstream's published 64-bit Windows archive for the validated release candidate. Its digest is GitHub's, published with the release asset. It does not print F0's hashes: it prints the tags (openEMS v0.37.0-rc3, CSXCAD v0.7.0-rc3), which pin exactly F0's two commits, so SolverDiscovery's validated entry accepts both spellings (first Windows install, 2026-09-30).
layoutNote: Upstream's binary archive: the programs load their libraries from beside themselves, so the home is built in .partial and renamed into place.
